visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men in sunglasses and dark casual clothing are seen from a high angle through a car's sunroof. They wave and gesture with peace signs at the camera as the teal-green vehicle remains stationary. The lighting is bright, direct natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a vertical drone shot looking directly down at the teal car as it drives along a coastal road. Stylized white Chinese text overlays the left side of the screen along with smaller English text. (3) A series of sweeping aerial shots showcase a Mediterranean-style coastal city with white buildings and red-tiled roofs. The city is nestled between rugged grey mountains and a vibrant turquoise sea. (4) The drone tracks along a winding road surrounded by lush green pine forests and rocky cliffs overhanging the ocean. (5) A wide shot of a harbor reveals hundreds of white boats and yachts docked in neat rows. (6) A large Turkish flag is visible, painted onto the side of a rocky hillside overlooking the urban landscape. (7) The video concludes with high-altitude views of the shoreline, with the sea reflecting the bright sunlight and the city stretching along the coast.
